description: Defines the Netlink class providing an interface for manipulating IP addresses and routing tables via netlink sockets, including methods for retrieving link info, addresses, route info, and modifying routes and rules.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: A wrapper class for netlink socket operations to manipulate IP addresses and routing rules.

methods.name: GetLinkInfo
methods.description: Retrieves link information for a specified network interface.

methods.name: GetAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves IP addresses associated with a network interface.

methods.name: ChangeLocalAddress
methods.description: Modifies local IP addresses on a network interface.

methods.name: GetRouteInfo
methods.description: Fetches routing rules from the main routing table.

methods.name: ChangeRoute
methods.description: Adds, removes, or replaces routing rules.

methods.name: ChangeRule
methods.description: Adds, removes, or modifies routing policy rules.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a netlink message to the kernel.

methods.name: Recv
methods.description: Receives a netlink message from the kernel.
